title: DX11 SetDescriptorTable must differentiate SRV vs UAV table types
content: DX11's SetDescriptorTable was always routing to SRV binding (PSSetShaderResources/CSSetShaderResources), even for UAV_Table root parameters. Fix: check rootLayout.params[index].type — if UAV_Table, use CSSetUnorderedAccessViews instead. Added FindTextureUAVByPoolIndex and FindBufferUAVByPoolIndex to DX11Device to resolve pool indices to ID3D11UnorderedAccessView*. This was critical for IBL compute bake (irradiance/prefilter dispatches wrote to UAVs that were never bound).
